title: Qualify M3 numerical and statistics preview through full cross-vertical release gate
commitMessage: feat: qualify M3 numerical and statistics preview release gate

contribution.summary: Qualify M3's independent G-M3 gate after all seven numerical/statistics phases and 14 tasks/42 subtasks are durably done. Recheck M2 and science/native evidence, restore and build the complete .NET solution, run six admitted test suites, managed Math.NET smokes and foundation verification, and inspect four local NuGet packages. Require 31 cross-vertical oracles from a separate isolated consumer before closing only M3.
contribution.value: Establish a coherent bounded 0.4.0-preview numerical/statistics release with real package graph SHA-256s, complete phase provenance and independent Math-only consumers, without claiming public publication or external Decision/AURA admission.
debtChanges: Seven accepted M3 phase authorities and both work packages remain preserved; release-scoped verification explicitly covers 14 tasks and 42 subtasks.
A read-only C# gate validator rejects incomplete native/product status, unqualified scientific phase evidence, premature M4 and fabricated external Decision/MCDM adoption.
Six admitted foundation, quantity, IR, composition, numerics and statistics test suites plus the foundation chain and three managed Math.NET smokes are independently rerun at the explicit gate.
Four observed local product NuGet archives have checked net10.0 assemblies, direct dependency graphs, byte sizes and exact-build SHA-256 from a separate archive-only verifier.
An isolated package-only consumer with 31 independently named numerical/statistical oracles proves the transitive quantities/IR plus numerics/statistics graph without source or provider references.
Only M3 transitions to done and its execution cursor retires; M4 stays not-ready and the release is a local preview rather than public NuGet or stable 1.0.
No native BLAS, full public SVD, unobserved runtime platform, universal floating accuracy, cryptographic PRNG, Decision/MCDM migration, AURA skill or neutral dw.discovery readiness is claimed.
C# compilation preflight uses separate managed-provider smokeOutput and NuGet consumer output local bindings; this corrects the CS0136 pre-attempt refusal without changing gate scope or criteria.

The second RS052 pre-attempt refusal was consumer compile diagnostic CS8629; explicit non-null Pearson pattern matching now guards the independent positive-correlation oracle without altering 31 probes.
contribution.nextAction: After RS052 durable success, examine M4 symbolic scope and native DWF dependencies, then prepare its first admitted bounded run without reinterpreting unqualified M3 extensions.

achievements.achievement: Complete qualified local M3 / 0.4.0-preview by validating all seven phase proofs, fourteen tasks/forty-two subtasks, six test projects, three managed provider smokes, the foundation chain, fresh four-product NuGet graph and 31 independent cross-vertical consumer oracles with actual local package identities and SHA-256 receipts, leaving M4 and external integration unadmitted.
